---
title: "Roadmap"
output: rmarkdown::html_vignette
vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Roadmap}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::rmarkdown}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

```{r roadmap-content, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
# Single source of truth: the repo-root ROADMAP.md. This vignette renders that
# file verbatim so the two can never drift apart -- edit ROADMAP.md, not this.
# The path differs between `R CMD build` (knits in vignettes/) and pkgdown
# (knits at the package root), so try both.
path <- if (file.exists("../ROADMAP.md")) "../ROADMAP.md" else "ROADMAP.md"
lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")

# Drop the leading `# Roadmap` title -- the vignette YAML already renders one.
if (length(lines) && grepl("^# ", lines[1])) {
  lines <- lines[-1]
  while (length(lines) && !nzchar(lines[1])) lines <- lines[-1]
}

cat(lines, sep = "\n")
```
